title: CURE4Rec: A Benchmark for Recommendation Unlearning with Deeper Influence
reasoning: The paper focuses on recommendation unlearning and includes a 'Recommendation Fairness' component as one of its four evaluation aspects, focusing on group fairness (active vs. inactive users). While fairness is a pillar of AI ethics, the paper focuses on technical algorithmic bias and privacy-related unlearning rather than benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or broader philosophical moral systems.
